answer_1.quote: we propose a novel and comprehensive multilevel feedback framework for training peer counseling skills co-designed with senior psychotherapy supervisors.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates multi-level feedback for peer counselor utterances, including appropriateness, goal alignment, areas for improvement, and alternative responses.

answer_2.quote: We use the automatically-computed quality scores (as defined in Section 5.2) as one way to evaluate the performance of our self-improvement method against baselines.

answer_4.quote: We asked domain experts to rate the feedback quality of the bottom 1% of generations using a 5-point Likert scale for M SFT and M self-imp.
answer_4.guideline: Experts evaluated feedback along eight aspects: Selection for Feedback, Strengths Identification, Improvement Areas Selection, Goal Description Quality, Rationale for Alternatives, Quality of Alternatives, Feedback Style, and Feedback Helpfulness.
